links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-generated cataract leaflet (Flesch Reading Ease and rater-perceived readability)
links.effect: ChatGPT leaflet had the lowest Flesch Reading Ease score of the three leaflets, yet doctors rated it most readable. Some patients favoured it for clarity and readability.
links.quote: ChatGPT had the lowest Flesch Reading Ease score but doctors rated it most readable.

unlisted_practices: Comparing AI-generated patient information leaflets against hospital-authored leaflets using clinician (DISCERN) and patient ratings

screen.reason: Evaluates patient information leaflets generated by ChatGPT compared to hospital-produced leaflets using evaluations by ophthalmologists and patients, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
